tools.name: get_best_forecast_model
tools.description: Find which weather forecast model had the lowest verified historical error (MAE) for a latitude/longitude coordinate (or station_or_report_id), weather variable (temperature, wind_speed, precipitation, humidity), and forecast horizon (Days 0-7). All 45 FACT models: WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteobl

tools.name: check_ground_truth_coverage
tools.description: Check historical WeatherXM FACT ground-station publication coverage for any coordinate (H3 Res-7 cell, ~5.2 km²) or station_or_report_id, plus nearest evaluated reference cell distance and interactive map citation link. Useful when assessing microclimate sensor coverage for farms, solar/wind assets,

tools.name: get_fact_leaderboard
tools.description: Read the global weather forecast accuracy leaderboard (MAE, RMSE, and categorical rain skill HSS, POD, FAR, CSI across lead days 0..7) or country-level published H3 cell-win summaries across all 45 forecast models and 8,927 stations. All 45 FACT models: WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteoblue (METEOBLU

tools.name: get_model_head_to_head
tools.description: Compare up to 10 weather forecast models head-to-head across lead days 0 to 7 on global historical error curves, with explicit cohort and station-commissioned (mLM) caveats. All 45 FACT models: WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteoblue (METEOBLUE), meteoblue station-mLM (mLM), ECMWF IFS (IFS025, IFSHRES)
